# Job Description - Security Architect

---

> **Position**: Security Architect
> **Department**: Enterprise Architecture Practice
> **Reports To**: Senior Enterprise Architect
> **Location**: Remote/Hybrid
> **Classification**: Full-time

---
page_texts.2:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#position-summary]

## Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Security Architect to join our Enterprise Architecture Practice (EAP) team. This role will design and implement comprehensive security architectures for Gainwell Technologies' healthcare portfolio, ensuring protection of sensitive healthcare data while maintaining compliance with federal and state regulations including HIPAA, FedRAMP, and FISMA requirements.

---
page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#security-architecture-design]

### Security Architecture Design

- Design enterprise security architecture aligned with healthcare compliance requirements and ERA principles
- Develop security frameworks, standards, and guidelines for healthcare systems and applications
- Create threat models and security risk assessments for healthcare technology solutions
- Design defense-in-depth security strategies across all technology layers
page_texts.5:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#healthcare-compliance--governance]

### Healthcare Compliance & Governance

- Ensure security architecture compliance with HIPAA, HITECH, FedRAMP, and FISMA requirements
- Design security controls for healthcare data protection and privacy
- Develop security governance frameworks and audit procedures
- Support state and federal security compliance reporting and assessments
page_texts.6:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#identity--access-management]

### Identity & Access Management

- Design enterprise identity and access management (IAM) solutions
- Implement role-based access control (RBAC) and attribute-based access control (ABAC) frameworks
- Design multi-factor authentication and privileged access management solutions
- Create identity federation and single sign-on (SSO) architectures for healthcare systems
page_texts.7:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#cloud-security-architecture]

### Cloud Security Architecture

- Design secure cloud architectures for AWS and Azure healthcare deployments
- Implement cloud security controls and monitoring frameworks
- Design hybrid cloud security solutions and network segmentation
- Ensure cloud compliance with healthcare regulations and government security requirements
page_texts.8:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#security-technology-implementation]

### Security Technology Implementation

- Lead implementation of security technologies including SIEM, SOAR, and security analytics platforms
- Design encryption strategies for data at rest, in transit, and in use
- Implement security monitoring and incident response capabilities
- Design API security and microservices security patterns

---
page_texts.10:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#education]

### Education

- **Minimum**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or related field
- **Preferred**: Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, or relevant technical field
page_texts.11:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#experience]

### Experience

- **Required**: 7+ years of experience in security architecture and cybersecurity
- **Required**: 3+ years of experience with healthcare security and HIPAA compliance
- **Preferred**: 5+ years of experience in government or regulated industry security
page_texts.13:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#security-architecture-skills]

#### Security Architecture Skills

- Enterprise security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT)
- Threat modeling and security risk assessment methodologies
- Security architecture design and documentation
- Security governance and compliance frameworks
page_texts.14:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#healthcare-security-expertise]

#### Healthcare Security Expertise

- HIPAA, HITECH, and healthcare privacy regulations
- FedRAMP and FISMA compliance frameworks
- Healthcare data protection and encryption standards
- Medical device security and FDA cybersecurity guidelines
page_texts.15:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#security-technologies]

#### Security Technologies

- Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms (Okta, Azure AD, AWS IAM)
- Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems
- Cloud security platforms and tools (AWS Security Hub, Azure Security Center)
- Encryption technologies and key management systems
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#cloud-security]

#### Cloud Security

- AWS security services (IAM, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, Config)
- Azure security services (Azure Security Center, Sentinel, Key Vault)
- Container security (Docker, Kubernetes security)
- DevSecOps practices and security automation
page_texts.17:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#documentation--ai-tools]

#### Documentation & AI Tools

- Markdown and documentation-as-code practices for security documentation
- Experience with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Amazon CodeWhisperer, etc.)
- Generative AI tools for security architecture design and threat analysis
- AI agents for security automation, compliance checking, and vulnerability assessment
page_texts.19:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#required]

#### Required

- **One of**: CISSP, SABSA, TOGAF with security focus, or equivalent security architecture certification
page_texts.20:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#preferred]

#### Preferred

- AWS Certified Security - Specialty or Azure Security Engineer Associate
- CISM, CISA, or CISSP concentrations
- Healthcare security certifications (HCISPP)

---
page_texts.22:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#specialized-experience]

### Specialized Experience

- Experience with Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS) security
- Knowledge of state government security requirements and frameworks
- Understanding of healthcare interoperability security (X12 EDI, NCPDP, FHIR, HL7 security)
- Experience with medical device integration and IoT security
page_texts.23:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#advanced-security-areas]

### Advanced Security Areas

- Zero Trust architecture design and implementation
- AI/ML security and privacy-preserving technologies
- Blockchain security for healthcare applications
- Quantum-resistant cryptography and post-quantum security
- Experience with Generative AI security, model governance, and responsible AI implementation
page_texts.24:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#industry--regulatory]

### Industry & Regulatory

- Experience with healthcare audits and security assessments
- Knowledge of state Medicaid security requirements
- Understanding of CMS security guidelines and requirements
- Experience with multi-state healthcare program security

---
page_texts.26:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#technical-competencies]

### Technical Competencies

- **Security Design**: Expertise in designing comprehensive security architectures
- **Risk Management**: Advanced risk assessment and mitigation capabilities
- **Compliance Management**: Deep understanding of healthcare and government compliance
- **Threat Analysis**: Ability to analyze and respond to emerging security threats
page_texts.27:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#business-competencies]

### Business Competencies

- **Healthcare Domain**: Understanding of healthcare business processes and security risks
- **Regulatory Knowledge**: Expertise in healthcare and government regulations
- **Stakeholder Management**: Ability to communicate security requirements to diverse audiences
- **Business Continuity**: Understanding of security's role in business operations
page_texts.28:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#leadership-competencies]

### Leadership Competencies

- **Security Leadership**: Ability to lead security initiatives and influence security culture
- **Strategic Thinking**: Capability to align security strategy with business objectives
- **Crisis Management**: Skills in security incident response and crisis leadership
- **Education & Training**: Ability to educate and train others on security practices

---
page_texts.30:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#security-architecture-delivery]

### Security Architecture Delivery

- Design and implement robust security architectures for healthcare systems
- Ensure security architecture alignment with enterprise architecture standards
- Support successful security implementations and deployments
- Maintain security architecture documentation and compliance artifacts
page_texts.31:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/security-architect.md#compliance--risk-management]

### Compliance & Risk Management

- Ensure all security solutions meet healthcare regulatory requirements
- Implement security monitoring and compliance reporting processes
- Support security audits and assessment activities
- Maintain security risk registers and mitigation strategies
